ticket.summary: MuleSoft | APIGEE -Mule conversion | Develop Product Registration process API for SFDC
ticket.description: Develop a new process API in Mule called Product Registration API according to Newell standards, based on SFDC_ProductRegistration_Proxy and SFDC_Replacement_Parts_Lookup Apigee proxies. Must replicate the same business logic, use newell-common-core for error logging into Crowdstrike. Analyze Newell brands repos to identify reusable APIs before building new ones.

securityModel.description: SFDC JWT auth via downstream call to sys-sfscnwl-api-v1 — no inline JWT subflow.

successCriteria: RAML spec at src/main/resources/api/prc-product-registration-api.raml is source of truth
APIKit router dispatches POST /product-registration and GET /replacement-parts
newell-common-core-v1 used for global error handler and Crowdstrike logging
Email blacklist and brand whitelist validation in rf-post-product-registration.xml
SFDC auth delegates to sys-sfscnwl-api-v1 via HTTP
Replacement parts returns 404 when SFCC response total == 0

securityModel.description: SFDC JWT auth via downstream call to sys-sfscnwl-api-v1 — no inline JWT subflow.

architecture.securityRecommendation: Preserve the current JWT bearer or OAuth exchange pattern behind the generated Mule app and keep the exact auth hook explicit.
implementationNotes: Use RAML as the source of truth.
Keep existing Mule repos read-only and surface extension guidance separately.
Generate a new ACB-importable Mule app even when an extension candidate exists.

existingApiScan.whyNotReuseAsIs: No strong existing Mule repo match was found for product-registration, so a new app is still the safest v1 output.
existingApiScan.newAppStillRequired: This agent is scoped to produce one new deployable Mule app per ticket while separately reporting which existing asset could be reused or extended later.

# int-mulesoft-prc-product-registration-api-v1

Generated by mulesoft-coding-agent from Jira ticket IT-49.

## Summary

- Capability: product-registration
- API layer: process
- Architecture decision: create new API
- Topology: experience->process->system
- Mock mode: enabled by default in local properties

## Local Run

1. Keep `app.mockMode=true` in `src/main/resources/properties/local.yaml`
2. Open the project in Anypoint Code Builder and run locally
3. The generated bootstrap points to the local property set by default for a zero-setup first run
4. Switch mock mode off only after filling the secure-property placeholders and rewiring env promotion as needed
